verdict.rationale: SAM.gov's Entity Management API lets a user look up an entity by UEI or legal business name. It can also filter by registration state (samRegistered=No returns entities not yet registered or ID-assigned), so registration status is retrievable for public-tier data. However, this is an API that needs a Public API Key tied to a SAM.gov account, not a status page anyone can open. Missing for 10: a documented public web page for checking registration or application status without an account or key, explicit status fields such as pending, active or expired, and hands-on corroboration that a founder can find their own filing status.
